# Morph Bot Component (Trimmed for forbotsonly)

Minimal runtime for decorative morphing bot. Dialogue, Chinese TTS, and demo files removed.

## Files

- `morph-bot.js` - Web component entry (dialogue removed)
- `grok-bot-engine.js` - Core animation engine
- `original-data.js` - Shape/state geometry (mark generation source)
- `catalog.js` - State/shape IDs
- `materials.js` - Material presets
- `runtime/` - Physics, rendering, particles

## Usage

See `/public/vendor/grokbot-animation/README.md` for usage examples.
